name: The Choice
source: This novel tells the story of a young and rich womanizer who picks up a bored beauty in a bar. Whether this meeting will be pleasant for her or will turn out to be a sexual nightmare is up to you, the Player.
translation: 这部小说讲述了一个年轻富有的好色之徒在酒吧里邂逅了一个百无聊赖的美女的故事。这次会面对她来说是愉快还是一场性噩梦取决于你，玩家。
